attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file PA Corporate Net Income Tax return. PA has $500,000 economic nexus threshold (higher than typical $100K).

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in PA (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - PA CNIT filing required // Apportionment calculated by federal tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
PA Corporate Net Income Tax filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in Pennsylvania).
Physical presence establishes nexus regardless of revenue amount.
Reference: PA Code Title 72 § 7401(3)2.(a)(15) Reference: Complete Quill Corp. v. North Dakota, 504 U.S. 298 (1992) Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018)

actions.action: // Economic nexus established - PA CNIT filing required // PA uses $500,000 threshold (higher than typical $100K)

rule.policy:
PA Corporate Net Income Tax filing required due to economic nexus.
Pennsylvania economic nexus threshold: $500,000 gross receipts (higher than the typical $100,000 threshold used by most states).
No transaction count threshold - receipts only.
Reference: PA Code Title 72 § 7401(3)2.(a)(15)(C) Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: PA Department of Revenue Tax Bulletin 2019-01

No PA nexus - no filing requirement. Any PA estimated tax payments would be refunded.
Reference: PA Code Title 72 § 7401(3)2.(a)(15)

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate PA state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate PA adjustments

rule.policy:
PA state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
PA ADDITIONS (increase PA taxable income): 1. Interest on U.S. government obligations (federally exempt, PA taxable) 2. IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback 3. State/local income taxes deducted federally 4. Bonus depreciation (PA may decouple from federal provisions)
PA SUBTRACTIONS (decrease PA taxable income): 1. Interest on PA state and municipal bonds (PA exempt) 2. Dividend income - 100% dividends received deduction (qualified) 3. PA Net Operating Loss deduction (80% limitation similar to federal) 4. Foreign dividend gross-up (IRC § 78)
Reference: PA Code Title 72 § 7401(3)1.(b) (Definitions - Additions/Subtractions) Reference: PA Form RCT-101 Schedule A (Computation of PA Taxable Income) Reference: PA Department of Revenue Corporation Tax Bulletin 2018-01
No PA nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate PA Corporate Net Income Tax (CNIT). Applies PA 8.99% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe PA tax

rule.policy:
PA Corporate Net Income Tax (CNIT) calculation:
1. Federal taxable income (Form 1120 line 28) 2. Apportioned to PA (100% single-sales factor, PA Code § 7401(3)2.(a)(17)) × PA apportionment percentage 3. PA additions (federal interest, 199A addback, state taxes) + Additions 4. PA subtractions (PA municipal interest, dividends, PA NOL) - Subtractions 5. PA taxable income = Result 6. PA tax rate (8.99% - one of highest state corporate rates) × 0.0899 7. PA Corporate Net Income Tax (before credits) = Tax liability 8. PA tax credits (R&D, Manufacturing, Film, Job Creation, KOZ) - Credits 9. PA CNIT liability = Final tax
PA TAX RATE: 8.99% (flat rate, no brackets) This is one of the highest state corporate income tax rates in the U.S.
PA APPORTIONMENT: 100% single-sales factor (receipts only) - No property or payroll factors - Market-based sourcing for services - Destination sourcing for goods
PA TAX CREDITS (common): - Research & Development Tax Credit - Manufacturing Tax Credit (Job Creation) - Film Production Tax Credit - Keystone Opportunity Zone (KOZ) Tax Credit - Historic Preservation Tax Credit
ESTIMATED TAX: Corporations with PA tax liability > $1,000 must make quarterly estimated payments (Form REV-1640).
Reference: PA Code Title 72 § 7401(3)1.(a) (8.99% tax rate) Reference: PA Code Title 72 § 7401(3)2.(a)(17) (Single-sales apportionment) Reference: PA Form RCT-101 (PA Corporate Tax Report) Reference: PA Form RCT-101V (Payment Voucher) Reference: PA Department of Revenue Corporation Tax Guide

No PA nexus - no tax liability. Any PA estimated tax payments are refunded.
Reference: PA Code Title 72 § 7401(3)2.(a)(15)

No PA taxable income - no tax liability.
PA Net Operating Loss (NOL): - PA NOLs may be carried forward indefinitely - 80% limitation applies (similar to federal post-TCJA) - PA NOL is calculated separately from federal NOL - Apportionment applies to NOL generation year
Any PA estimated tax payments are refunded.
Reference: PA Code Title 72 § 7401(3)1.(b)(2)(B)(III) (PA NOL deduction) Reference: PA Form RCT-101 Schedule D (Net Operating Loss Deduction)
